items:
A work 
 permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area.
Wear your safety helmet, shoes ... etc
Isolate the circuit breaker of the fan motor
Disconnect electric terminals of fan motor
The fan must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery damper
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller,
Feeler gauge, dial indicator

Vibrometer 
 straight edge

sections.text: Sling up the rotor and put it down on the maintenance area.
Remove the bearing using a hub puller.

items: Disconnect the electric motors.
Remove all the different guards.
Uncouple the electric motor.

Remove all the auxiliary equipments installed on the bearings 
 pyrometric probes.
Discharge the bearings of their oil.
Break away the shaft tighness from the intel vane control.
Disconnect the shaped inlets from the inlet vane control.

Remove the upper part of the fan casing and the 2 inlet vane 
 control upper.

REMARK : Normally all the bearing 
 compounds are marked in order to avoid any mistake during the reassembly.

Unscrew the two side parts of each bearing taking care to not 
 damage the gaskets.

Remove the upper part of each bearing taking care to not 
 damage the gaskets.

REMARK: We advise to put the rotor 
 on wooden made supports in order to avoid to damage the shaft or the impeller.
Remove the half coupling from the shaft.
Remove the backstop from the shaft.
Remove the central bolt of each bearing
Slide the outer side of each bearing to the shaft tip.
Slide the outer spacers to the shaft tips.

REMARK: an already used rolling 
 bearing can not be reused after dismantling.

Check that the shaft has no 
 damage

Install the rolling bearings on 
 the shaft as indicated hereunder :

The rolling bearings are installed tightened on 
 the shaft.

Check that rolling bearing have no foreign 
 substances, in this case, clean them white spirit or petrol

Heat the rolling bearing in an oil bath at a 
 temperature of 100 
 C 
 to 120 
 C 
 without exceeding 120
 C

Check that the oil rings are well installed on 
 the outer spacers stayed in place

Slid the rolling bearing on the shaft and lock 
 them against the inner spacers
Assemble the brake washers
Screw the central bolts and brake washers
Assemble the half coupling
Sling the rotor

Sling up the rotor and install it on its place on 
 the casing
Assemble the upper parts of bearing housings
Fill the bearing with oil .

Assemble the remaining parts of the fan in the 
 reverse order of the disassembly
